summary: Iteration 34: Backend-only testing of Batch 4 - Sticky Card Monitoring & Alerts. All 33 tests pass. Key features verified: (1) MonitoringEvent model with all required fields, (2) CustomPositionResponse has monitoring_events field, (3) position_monitor.py check_news_impact/check_regime_shift/check_urgent_exit functions work correctly, (4) generate_position_alerts aggregates alerts in priority order, (5) GET /api/fno/position-alerts endpoint returns aggregated alerts, (6) GET /api/fno/custom-positions returns monitoring_events in each position. One bug documented: direction detection uses 'CE in script' which incorrectly matches symbols like RELIANCE.

minor.issue: Direction detection bug: 'CE in script' incorrectly matches symbols containing 'CE' like RELIANCE (RELIAN-CE), ICICIBANK, etc. PE scripts for these symbols are detected as LONG instead of SHORT.
minor.fix_suggestion: Use script.endswith('CE') or check option_type field instead of 'CE in script'

key_findings.monitoring_event_model: CONFIRMED — MonitoringEvent model exists with fields: type, symbol, underlying, script, direction, timestamp, severity, reason, details
key_findings.custom_position_response: CONFIRMED — CustomPositionResponse has monitoring_events field (list of MonitoringEvent, defaults to empty)
key_findings.check_news_impact: CONFIRMED — Triggers for LONG+NEGATIVE and SHORT+POSITIVE, does NOT trigger for NEUTRAL
key_findings.check_regime_shift: CONFIRMED — Triggers for material regime change (LowVolTrend→HighVolCrash) with P_hit drop
key_findings.check_urgent_exit: CONFIRMED — Triggers when underwater + low recovery + adverse flow + <90min remaining
key_findings.generate_position_alerts: CONFIRMED — Aggregates all 3 alert types in priority order (URGENT_EXIT > REGIME_SHIFT > NEWS_IMPACT)
key_findings.position_alerts_endpoint: CONFIRMED — GET /api/fno/position-alerts returns {alerts: [], count: N} sorted by severity
key_findings.custom_positions_endpoint: CONFIRMED — Returns monitoring_events field in each position response
key_findings.no_regression: CONFIRMED — Existing endpoints (auth, custom-positions) still work

action_items: FIX (MEDIUM): position_monitor.py direction detection bug - change 'CE in script' to 'script.endswith("CE")' or check option_type field. Affects symbols like RELIANCE, ICICIBANK that contain 'CE' in their name.

MonitoringEvent model correctly uses Field(default_factory=dict) for details field
_build_monitoring_events helper correctly extracts non-common keys into details dict
Monitoring block in _refresh_open_position correctly handles exceptions and logs verbose output
/api/fno/position-alerts endpoint correctly sorts by severity (CRITICAL > HIGH > MEDIUM > LOW)
